author: Widogeist
body:
With that low of base HP, you're better off force closing the game, re-entering tower and avoiding that fight altogether.  If that fight is preventing you from progressing to the next floor, you should probably just leave the tower and keep the shards you have.

If you want to be risky, MGS will be helpful in this situation for the passive dragon resistance.  It looks like you're on summoner; you should force close and re-open anyway to start the fight over again until you have 2 summons up at the start of battle.  Start off with Ward of Mythril, pray you don't die next turn, then fill the battlefield up with 1-turn summons. Keep ward turns up, spam panaceas, and use stun dart when able for the off chance of making one of the bosses skip their turn.

author: dreambig5
body:
Try closing the game and going back in to see if you're able to start the battle with a summon atleast. Other than that, ward for sure. I usually put Ward of Mythril or Ornatite in the first spell slot (whatever the best one I have that grants ward for multiple turns and damage absorption). 

I forgot what level you unlock Ancient Jinn but it's usually one of my first spawns as it helps with taking on mobs. That combined with my tankiest/strongest summon to go with. 

Btw. Glad  to hear you managed to survive this! It's a dangeous position to be in.
